policy.checkpoint_selection: Each explicit checkpoint was selected by lowest validation MSE, before this test evaluation.
policy.test_selection: No model, seed, checkpoint or waveform case is selected using these test results.
policy.prior_test_exposure: The existing seed-42 baseline test result was already inspected, as disclosed by the user; this is not a wholly unseen-test workflow.
policy.seed_interpretation: Three training seeds on the same data split and the same 100 test ECGs; not three independent test cohorts.
policy.seed_mean_rmse: Arithmetic mean of three seed-specific pooled RMSE values; SD uses ddof=1.
policy.all_seed_pooled_rmse: sqrt(total squared error / total elements across three seeds); repeats the same 100 ECGs three times and differs from mean seed RMSE.
policy.aggregation: Convert predictions and targets separately to float64 before subtraction; float64 sums; overall excludes observed Lead I; RMSE=sqrt(MSE).
